name: Startup Buffer

sources.title: Startup Buffer submission form (returned 403 to automated fetch; fields documented by third parties)
Startup Buffer homepage — premium startup directory
Third-party field-level walkthrough of the Startup Buffer submission

requirements: No account is created — the form is anonymous; a private edit link is emailed to the address you enter
Required: startup name, live URL, a business email you actually read, a one-sentence pitch, a description of at least 3-4 sentences, and a screenshot under 500KB
Optional: country, city, primary category, tags, video, social links — used to place the profile on market/location pages
Site operating since 2015; outbound product link is a plain rel="noopener" followed link
preparation: A screenshot compressed under 500KB — the form's only hard limit and a common failure (a normal full-width screenshot exceeds it)
One-sentence pitch plus a 3-4+ sentence description
The right business email — it is the ONLY way back to edit the listing later
workflow: Fill mandatory fields (name, URL, email, pitch, description) and optional discovery fields
Upload the <500KB screenshot at the end of the form
Submit — you land on a promotion page confirming the submission is in review
Save the private edit link that arrives by email
watchFor: Post-submit redirect lands on a paid promotion upsell — submission itself is already in; no payment needed
Screenshot cap is strictly 500KB — compress before uploading
Losing the emailed edit link means losing edit access permanently (no account recovery)
Free vs premium listing exists — premium buys featured placement, but pricing was not visible on public pages
Submit page returned 403 to an automated reader — may block non-browser agents
countsAsLive: A startup profile page on startupbuffer.com carrying the pitch, description, screenshot, category/tags and country — cross-linked from market and location pages.
unknowns: Review duration before the listing goes live
Whether the profile link is dofollow on all listings or only approved ones
